newsitem.title: USA: US spot LPGs rise amid sharp gains on NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: US spot LPGs rise amid sharp gains on NYMEX.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices were called stronger in quiet trade on Tuesday amid a sharp rise in NYMEX futures, players said.
In Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane rose a half cent to between 35.00 cents and 35.50 cents, with 35.25 cent done.
Belvieu normal butane jumped more than a cent amid sudden demand, trading between 40.25/40.50 cents. The ethane markets were also stronger.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
